name: Handwart Unsichtbar
personality: Has found the missing hand and is still unsure who is wearing the explanation.
visual_intent: Invisible Hand Glove: tall narrow hooked ink blob,little plum clerk cap,tiny cream collar,ONE EMPTY ivory formal glove held upright by cuff in own goo hand,other hand small brass balance weight,no extra living hand. Huge unequal eyes inspecting glove,tiny toothless triangular open mouth
biography: Has found the missing hand and is still unsure who is wearing the explanation. His empty HyperNorm glove gestures toward an explanation nobody claims to own. A dissonant card asks whose hand would fit inside if the room stopped looking away. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Hand ist gefunden. Ihre Zuständigkeit gilt als unsichtbar.

name: Herr Wiegehabt
personality: Is making steady progress toward exactly where he already was.
visual_intent: Status Quo Rocking Chair adapted upright: broad low square ink splat,small rust sleeping cap,tiny teal collar,ONE miniature wooden rocking chair held firmly at flank,not sitting,no floor. Extremely heavy uneven eyelids,huge closed toothless pout,goo body whole
biography: Is making steady progress toward exactly where he already was. His miniature HyperNorm chair provides movement without an inconvenient change of place. A dissonant card asks whether comfort is the same as consent. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Bewegung bleibt dem bewährten Standort verpflichtet.

name: Torhüterin Schlüsselrecht
personality: Enjoys helping people discover that permission was the missing qualification.
visual_intent: Gatekeeper with Keys: round top-heavy ink blob,small cream peaked cap,two subtle lashes,tiny plum collar,ONE large brass keyring with THREE chunky different keys and small blank permission card. Fierce delighted crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,one brow high
biography: Enjoys helping people discover that permission was the missing qualification. Her HyperNorm keys confirm that access exists while keeping it conditional. A dissonant card asks why the person waiting must prove the door should open. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Die fehlende Eignung besteht vorläufig in fehlender Erlaubnis.

name: Aufsteiger Nächstergrad
personality: Can name the next rung more easily than the reason for reaching it.
visual_intent: Social Ladder Climber upright metaphor: tall curved pear ink blob,small tan office cap,tiny burgundy tie,ONE miniature TEAL WOODEN THREE-RUNG ladder with THREE different blank medal-tags clipped to rungs,held beside body,no climbing scene. Huge anxious unequal eyes gazing upward,closed toothless nervous wavy mouth
biography: Can name the next rung more easily than the reason for reaching it. His HyperNorm ladder names every next rank more clearly than the destination. A dissonant card asks who is holding it while he looks upward. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Die nächste Stufe ist unabhängig vom Ziel eindeutig.

name: Regelwart Bekanntlich
personality: Finds it obvious once someone else has been punished for not knowing.
visual_intent: Unwritten Rule Book blank: squat broad asymmetric ink splat,little dark scholar cap,tiny cream collar,ONE OPEN thick book showing TWO completely BLANK ivory pages,no marks or letters,one goo finger indicates empty page. Hooded skeptical eyes,closed toothless crooked side-mouth
biography: Finds it obvious once someone else has been punished for not knowing. His blank HyperNorm book becomes obvious the moment somebody breaks an unwritten rule. A dissonant card asks whether explanation might arrive before punishment. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Regel ist bekannt, sobald ihre Unkenntnis Folgen hat.

name: Fluraufsicht Soüblich
personality: Protects the corridor from people arriving with an unapproved manner of walking.
visual_intent: Norm Enforcer Hall Monitor: tall broad-based ink pear,little teal hall-monitor cap,two lashes,tiny cream shoulder tabs,ONE metal whistle and small wooden clipboard with blank pass sheet. Huge officious crooked open bellow with THREE upper teeth,one eye narrowed
biography: Protects the corridor from people arriving with an unapproved manner of walking. Her HyperNorm whistle protects a corridor whose permitted pace keeps changing. A dissonant card asks whether arriving differently must count as an obstruction. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Flur wird gegen ungewohnte Arten des Ankommens gesichert.
